answer: One workable design: let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because hollow only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. Concretely, yarrow is enforced in the ledger: Detection is retrospective: payouts for a flagged cluster are clawed back after the fact. Any ridge approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
